name: Apple account
author: Enplace
summary: Sign in to App Store Connect once, for the App Store, TestFlight and Xcode Cloud.
description: Add an App Store Connect API key once and pick which account each app uses. The App Store, TestFlight and Xcode Cloud plugins sign in with it, and GitHub Actions can put it in a repo's secrets for your workflows. Enplace checks the key works and which apps it can see.

settings.name: Issuer ID
settings.help: App Store Connect → Users and Access → Integrations → App Store Connect API, above the keys.

settings.name: Key ID
settings.help: The ID of the key you generated there.

settings.name: Private key (.p8)
settings.help: Paste the whole .p8 file, including the BEGIN and END lines.

settings.name: Vendor number
settings.help: For downloads and purchases. App Store Connect → Payments and Financial Reports, the number beside your name at the top. The key above also needs the Sales, Finance or Admin role.

connection.how: Generate a key with the App Manager or Admin role, then copy its issuer ID, key ID and .p8 file here.
